turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
y if it hasn’t been fulfilled yet and no tracking has been added.

Here’s the scoop:

If your order is still unfulfilled, it may be eligible for cancellation.
Once it’s fulfilled or tracking has been added, it’s no longer eligible to be canceled.
There isn’t a customer-facing “grace period” we can promise, since eligibility depends on how far along the order is in processing.

If you want, send me your order # or the email used at checkout and I’ll help check what’s possible 🙂

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?

Hi — usually, items can’t be added to an order once it’s already been placed. That’s definitely not the vibe we were going for, but the best move is usually to place a separate order for the extra item.

If you want, send me your order # or checkout email and I can help check whether there’s anything else possible with your existing order 🙂

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped — can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
ens if it already shipped — can it still be changed?

Hi — once an order has already shipped, it usually can’t be changed anymore. That includes things like canceling it, adding items, or editing what’s in the order.

Here’s the scoop:

If it’s already shipped/fulfilled, it’s no longer eligible for cancellation
Order changes are generally only possible before fulfillment
If you still want help checking a specific order, send your order # or checkout email and I’ll take a look 🙂
